text: Where is MESCOE located?,What is the college address?,How to reach MESCOE?,Location of college,MESCOE address Pune

text: What engineering courses are offered?,List of departments,Which branches are available in MESCOE?,UG courses in MESCOE
response: MESCOE offers B.E. degrees in Computer Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunication (E&TC), Mechanical Engineering, and Automation & Robotics.

text: How to apply for admission?,What is the admission procedure?,First year engineering admission process,CAP round admissions MESCOE
response: Admissions to B.E. programs are conducted through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) managed by the State CET Cell, Maharashtra based on MHT-CET / JEE Main scores.

text: What is the contact number for admission enquiry?,Admission cell phone number,Who to contact for admissions?
response: For admission enquiries, you can call 020-26163831 or email us at info@mescoepune.org.

text: What is the total intake for Computer Engineering?,How many seats in CS branch?,Computer Engg seat capacity
response: Computer Engineering has an intake capacity of 300 students for UG and 12 seats for PG (M.E.).

text: How many seats are there in E&TC?,Electronics and Telecommunication seat intake,ENTC branch capacity
response: E&TC Engineering has an intake capacity of 120 students for UG and 12 seats for PG (M.E.).

text: What is the seat intake for Mechanical Engineering?,Mechanical branch seats
response: Mechanical Engineering has an intake capacity of 60 students for UG and 12 seats for PG (M.E.).

text: How many seats in Automation and Robotics?,Robotics department seat intake
response: Automation & Robotics branch has an intake capacity of 60 students for UG.

text: What is the fee structure for B.E.?,How much are the college fees?,Fee details for first year engineering
response: The tuition and development fees are fixed annually as per the Fee Regulating Authority (FRA), Maharashtra. Category-wise fee concessions apply as per govt norms.

text: Does MESCOE provide hostel facility?,Is there a hostel for boys and girls?,Hostel fees and capacity
response: Yes, MESCOE provides separate hostel accommodations for both boys and girls within the campus with Wi-Fi, security, and mess facilities.

text: How are the campus placements?,Which companies visit MESCOE for placements?,Highest package in MESCOE,Placement record
response: MESCOE has a dedicated Placement Cell. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Cognizant, Accenture, L&T Infotech, and Capgemini with packages up to 10+ LPA.

text: What is the accreditation status of MESCOE?,Is MESCOE NAAC accredited?,SPPU affiliation status
response: MESCOE is accredited with 'A++' Grade by NAAC and is permanently affiliated with Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU).

text: Tell me about the college library,Are there digital library facilities?,Library timings and book count
response: The central library has over 30,000+ volumes, digital e-journals (IEEE, ScienceDirect), reading halls, and 24/7 internet access.

text: Is scholarship available for students?,EBC scholarship MESCOE,TFWS seats and SC ST scholarships
response: Yes, scholarships like MahaDBT (EBC, SC/ST/OBC/VSTJ) and TFWS (Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme) are applicable as per Maharashtra State Govt rules.

text: What are the office timings?,College timing for administrative office,Working hours
response: The administrative office functions from Monday to Saturday, 9:30 AM to 5:30 PM (except 2nd and 4th Saturdays and public holidays).

text: Is there a canteen on campus?,Food facilities in MESCOE
response: Yes, a hygienic campus canteen is available providing snacks, tea, coffee, and lunch options for students and staff.

text: What sports facilities are available?,Gymkhana and ground details in college
response: MESCOE features a sports complex with grounds for cricket, football, volleyball, basketball courts, and indoor games like chess and table tennis.

text: Who is the principal of MESCOE?,Name of college principal
response: The Principal of Modern Education Society's Wadia College of Engineering is Dr. S. S. Sarawade.

text: Does MESCOE have M.Tech or M.E. courses?,Postgraduate courses list
response: MESCOE offers M.E. (Master of Engineering) programs in Computer Engineering, E&TC (Signal Processing), and Mechanical Design Engineering.

text: What documents are required for admission?,First year engineering document checklist
response: Required documents include MHT-CET/JEE Scorecard, 10th & 12th Marksheets, Leaving Certificate, Domicile/Nationality Certificate, and Category/Caste certificates if applicable.

text: Are there student clubs and technical events?,Cultural fest and tech fest name
response: MESCOE conducts annual technical fests, cultural events like 'Nirmiti', NSS camps, and student chapters of IEEE, CSI, and MESA.

text: Where can I find exam timetables and syllabus?,SPPU exam schedules
response: Exam schedules, hall tickets, and syllabus updates are available on the SPPU official portal and notified on the college notice boards.
